The safety statement provided for the Fitbit Aria Wi-Fi Smart Scale indicates that it complies with the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) part 15.19 FCC Rules, and also adheres to the specifications of EN Standard: EN60950-1:2006 + A11:2009 + A1:2010 + A12:2011 + A2:2013.

A complete Declaration of Conformity can be found at www.fitbit.com/Aria/specs.

Additional warnings include: not using the scale if you have a pacemaker or any other internal medical device, not using it if you are pregnant, it's not intended for use by children under 10, and it should not be used to diagnose or treat any medical condition. Always consult your physician.

Other safety instructions include handling the batteries in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, avoiding dropping the scale, not using it if cracks are present on the glass surface, and not using abrasive cleaners to clean the scale. It should also not be exposed to extremely high or low temperatures, left in direct sunlight for an extended period of time, or left near open flames.
